entries.title: Psalms 73:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> Truly God [is] good to Israel, [even] to such as are of a clean heart. {of: or, for} {Truly: or, Yet} {of...: Heb. clean of heart}

words.text: , [even] to such as are of a clean
. {of: or, for} {Truly: or, Yet} {of...: Heb. clean of heart}

entries.title: Psalms 73:2
segments: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

words.text: But as for me, my feet

entries.title: Psalms 73:3
segments: For I was envious at the foolish, [when] I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 73:4
segments: For [there are] no bands in their death: but their strength [is] firm. {firm: Heb. fat}

entries.title: Psalms 73:5
segments: They [are] not in trouble [as other] men; neither are they plagued like [other] men. {in...: Heb. in the trouble of other men} {like: Heb. with}

words.text: . {in...: Heb. in the trouble of other men} {like: Heb. with}

entries.title: Psalms 73:6
segments: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them [as] a garment.

words.text: compasseth them about as a chain

entries.title: Psalms 73:7
segments: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish. {have...: Heb. pass the thoughts of the heart}

words.text: . {have...: Heb. pass the thoughts of the heart}

entries.title: Psalms 73:8
segments: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly [concerning] oppression: they speak loftily.

entries.title: Psalms 73:9
segments: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 73:10
segments: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full [cup] are wrung out to them.

entries.title: Psalms 73:11
segments: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

entries.title: Psalms 73:12
segments: Behold, these [are] the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase [in] riches.

entries.title: Psalms 73:13
segments: Verily I have cleansed my heart [in] vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

entries.title: Psalms 73:14
segments: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning. {chastened: Heb. my chastisement was}

entries.title: Psalms 73:15
segments: ¶If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend [against] the generation of thy children.

entries.title: Psalms 73:16
segments: When I thought to know this, it [was] too painful for me; {too...: Heb. labour in mine eyes}

entries.title: Psalms 73:17
segments: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; [then] understood I their end.

entries.title: Psalms 73:18
segments: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 73:19
segments: How are they [brought] into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

entries.title: Psalms 73:20
segments: As a dream when [one] awaketh; [so], O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

entries.title: Psalms 73:21
segments: ¶Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

entries.title: Psalms 73:22
segments: So foolish [was] I, and ignorant: I was [as] a beast before thee. {ignorant: Heb. I knew not} {before Heb. with}

words.text: before thee. {ignorant: Heb. I knew not} {before Heb. with}

entries.title: Psalms 73:23
segments: Nevertheless I [am] continually with thee: thou hast holden [me] by my right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 73:24
segments: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me [to] glory.

entries.title: Psalms 73:25
segments: Whom have I in heaven [but thee]? and [there is] none upon earth [that] I desire beside thee.

words.text: [but thee]? and [there is] none upon earth

entries.title: Psalms 73:26
segments: My flesh and my heart faileth: [but] God [is] the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever. {strength: Heb. rock}

entries.title: Psalms 73:27
segments: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

words.text: For, lo, they that are far
all them that go a whoring

entries.title: Psalms 73:28
segments: But [it is] good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
